title: Fan-funded creator platform
whyItFails: Crowded. Patreon and others dominate. Small creator incomes. Most earn little. Platform fees. Margins thin.

attempts.notes: Reversed a 2017 fee change after creator backlash; layoffs in 2020, 2021 and 2022.

attempts.outcome: Bought by Kickstarter, then shut down
attempts.notes: Kickstarter said serving small creators this way was unsustainable.

reasons.detail: Small creator incomes: Most earn little.
